authority: Owner 2026-09-27 (DESIGN_AUTHORITY answers 2, 4, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12): events on the road and on arrival, about one journey in three or four, a surprise, a bit of time, the first ones low-end hustling; later, bigger contacts and money; any can become a fight. Answer 11: keep writing more, none repeat. Answer 12: Kallio noir, dirty and dingy, weird people, and the money always short. 2026-09-28 (item 3): the network carries the Thursday Load. An event with a `trigger` is never rolled on the road; the story raises it.
fiction_boundary: Composite people and situations. The good is abstract (DESIGN_LOCKS §9.1): no dosage, preparation, concealment or consumption detail.

events.title: A kid on Hämeentie
events.text: A teenager in a borrowed parka falls into step beside Aatami and asks, too loudly, if he is holding. He is selling too — badly, to the wrong people.

choices.label: Trade a few words
choices.detail: He knows which kiosk is watched. You learn something; you lose a little time.

choices.label: Tell him to go home
choices.detail: He won't. But the corner remembers who said it.

choices.label: Walk on
choices.detail: Nothing gained, nothing spent.

events.title: Three stops, fifteen euros
events.text: A dealer Aatami half-knows from Piritori needs a bag carried three tram stops. Fifteen euros, no questions, and he will not ask twice.

choices.label: Carry it — €15
choices.detail: Small money, a small favour owed to you, and the tram takes its time.

choices.label: Not today
choices.detail: He shrugs. Somebody else will.

events.title: Ticket inspection
events.text: Two inspectors board at the Kurvi stop and work down the tram, checking tickets and faces.

choices.label: Stay seated, ticket ready
choices.detail: Slow, boring and safe.

choices.label: Get off at the next stop and walk
choices.detail: Nobody looks twice at a walker. It takes longer.

events.title: The kiosk regular
events.text: The man who is always at the kiosk says the buyers here were asking for more tonight, and paying for it.

choices.label: Buy him a coffee and listen
choices.detail: Two euros for a better read on the street.

choices.label: Nod and move on
choices.detail: Free, and forgotten.

events.title: Another seller
events.text: Someone else is working this corner — older, tired, in no hurry. He sizes Aatami up and offers to split the evening instead of fighting over it.

choices.label: Agree to split the corner
choices.detail: Less for you here, but one less enemy.

choices.label: Leave it to him
choices.detail: Walk away and keep your own counsel.

events.title: A torn pocket
events.text: Somewhere between stops the lining of Aatami's jacket gave way. One pack is not where it was.

choices.label: Retrace the route
choices.detail: Walk it back, slowly. You find it in the gutter by the stop.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.detail: Keep your time; lose the pack.

events.title: Someone from school
events.text: A face from Aatami's old class, now working the bar at a place on Vaasankatu. She remembers him, and she hears things.

choices.label: Have a drink and catch up
choices.detail: An hour gone, a contact made.

choices.label: Promise to call her
choices.detail: You will not. She knows it.

events.title: A bigger ask
events.text: A man with McCormick friends has heard Aatami is reliable. He wants a package moved across the district tonight. Forty euros, and the kind of attention that comes with it.

choices.label: Take the job — €40
choices.detail: Real money. The McCormick people will remember the name.

choices.label: Pass, politely
choices.detail: No money, no attention.

events.title: The underpass
events.text: Two Kurvi regulars block the underpass and want to know whose corner Aatami thinks he is working.

choices.label: Pay them off — €20
choices.detail: Cheap, humiliating, over.

choices.label: Go the long way round
choices.detail: An hour on foot through the back streets.

choices.label: Stand your ground with the crew
choices.detail: It becomes a fight. You will see their intent before you commit.

events.title: The pram full of radios
events.text: A woman pushes a pram with no baby in it, only transistor radios, all of them on, all on different stations. She stops beside Aatami as if they had arranged it.

choices.label: Pay her to tune one — €5
choices.detail: She finds the police band in four seconds and hands it to you. It hisses about Kurvi.

choices.label: Just listen for a minute
choices.detail: Six stations, one of them saying your street's name. Probably.

choices.label: Walk on
choices.detail: The radios follow you for half a block.

events.title: The man in the fur hat
events.text: He gets on at Kurvi, sits facing Aatami though the tram is empty, and says one word as if it were a password: "Forty-one."

choices.label: Ask him what it means
choices.detail: He smiles as if you had got it right, and gets off without answering. You remember the number.

choices.label: Change carriages
choices.detail: He watches you go. He is at the next stop anyway.

events.title: The bottle collector
events.text: An old man with a supermarket trolley of empties knows every back door in Kallio and which ones are open after midnight.

choices.label: Help him load the cart — €4
choices.detail: Four euros in deposit coins and a nod from the doors he trusts.

choices.label: Ask which doors
choices.detail: He names two and makes you promise not to use the third.

choices.label: Walk on
choices.detail: The trolley rattles away over the tramlines.

events.title: Steam from the basement
events.text: Steam pours out of a basement sauna vent onto the pavement. A man in nothing but a towel stands in it, smoking, and says the Hakaniemi buyers were short tonight.

choices.label: Stop and hear the rest
choices.detail: Who was short, who paid, who did not come. The towel man has a very good memory.

choices.label: Keep walking
choices.detail: Your coat smells of birch smoke for an hour.

events.title: The kiosk that never pays out
events.text: The late kiosk sells scratch cards from a roll so old the colours have faded. The clerk swears somebody won once, in 1994.

choices.label: Scratch one — €2
choices.detail: It says TRY AGAIN in Estonian. The clerk says that counts as a sign.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.detail: The roll stays where it is, waiting for 1994 to happen again.

events.title: A van with its engine running
events.text: A white van idles on Hämeentie with its engine running and nobody in it. The back doors are open. It is empty except for a single rubber boot.

choices.label: Note the plate and walk on
choices.detail: Toko counts vans. Now so do you.

choices.label: Cross the street and do not look
choices.detail: Whatever it is, it is not yours tonight.

events.title: Four bars on an accordion
events.text: A busker plays the same four bars of a tango over and over. When a patrol car turns the corner, he changes key.

choices.label: Pay him to keep watch — €5
choices.detail: He will change key for you too.

choices.label: Walk on
choices.detail: The tango goes on without you.

events.title: Someone has been asking
events.text: The barman on Helsinginkatu says Aatami's name before Aatami can say it. Somebody was in last night asking for him, and paid for their beer in markka.

choices.label: Ask who it was
choices.detail: A coat, a moustache, a Tampere accent, a very clean ten-markka note. It is not much. It is something.

choices.label: Finish nothing and leave
choices.detail: Knowing less is also a choice.

events.title: A buyer in a good coat
events.text: A buyer in a coat too good for Kallio wants three packs next week and offers thirty euros now, as a deposit, to make sure Aatami remembers him.

choices.label: Take the deposit — €30
choices.detail: Money now, a promise later. He writes your name on a napkin and keeps it.

choices.label: No promises
choices.detail: He shrugs, and folds the thirty back into the good coat.

events.title: The last night bus
events.text: The trams have stopped. The night bus driver says Aatami can ride free if he helps get the man asleep across the back seat off at Sörnäinen.

choices.label: Help, and ride free
choices.detail: The sleeper wakes, thanks you in Swedish and gives you a lighter with a stranger's name on it.

choices.label: Walk instead
choices.detail: Forty minutes on wet streets. At least nobody asks you anything.

events.title: They know about Thursdays
events.text: Two McCormick cousins are waiting where Kello usually stands. One of them is holding his cheap watch. They know somebody has been taking a cut of their Thursdays, and now they know who.

choices.label: Pay them off — €100
choices.detail: Cheap, all things considered. The cut ends tonight.

choices.label: Give them Kello
choices.detail: They were going to find him anyway. The McCormicks remember who helped. The cut ends.

choices.label: Stand with the crew
choices.detail: It becomes a fight. Win it and the cut goes on, with everyone watching.

events.title: Empties going the wrong way
events.text: The bottle collector is loading his trolley outside a closed bar. He has noticed the Thursday vans too: they leave empty and come back empty, and nobody who works a van ever does that.

choices.label: Buy him a coffee — €3
choices.detail: "The pram," he says. "Kurvi, 20:40, every Thursday. Goes back lighter."

choices.label: Walk on
choices.detail: He watches you go, and counts you too.

events.title: The man who stays asks the time
events.text: At the tram stop the man from the square falls into step beside Aatami. Kello. He asks the time, although he is wearing a watch.

choices.label: Tell him the right time
choices.detail: He checks it against his own and flinches. His watch runs five minutes fast, on purpose.

choices.label: Tell him it is later than it is
choices.detail: He hurries off toward Kurvi. Now you know which way he goes when he thinks he is late.

choices.label: Shrug and keep walking
choices.detail: He smiles as if you had answered anyway.

events.title: A McCormick cousin, asking
events.text: A young McCormick in a good leather jacket stops Aatami outside the kiosk. Since the bear, the family wants to know who sells air on Thursdays. He is paying for names.

choices.label: Sell him a rumour — €30
choices.detail: Nothing true enough to hurt anyone yet. The family remembers you helped.

choices.label: "Nobody I know"
choices.detail: He does not believe you. He writes your name down anyway.

events.title: The busker changes key
events.text: The accordion player you paid is on the corner. As Aatami turns into the street he changes key, loudly, twice. Up ahead, two patrol cars are parked where they are never parked.

choices.label: Take the long way round
choices.detail: Forty minutes through courtyards. Nobody stops you.

choices.label: Walk through anyway
choices.detail: They look. They let you go. The street remembers you walked past them.

events.title: The man from table two
events.text: The man who has eaten the same bowl at Toko's since 1998 is on the same tram, three seats back, not reading his newspaper. When Aatami gets off, so does he.

choices.label: Turn round and ask what he wants
choices.detail: "Everybody in Kallio is for sale, son. Somebody has bought you." He will not say who. Yet.

choices.label: Lose him in the market crowd
choices.detail: It takes half an hour. You are not sure it worked.
